new_findings.title: Checkout cancellation returns to the generic account screen
new_findings.defect: [TEST-31] The contract selects `/billing/cancel` as the default cancel URL (docs/specs/app-portal-account-billing-spec.md:200), and the backend constructs it (recognition/interface_adapters/http/routers/portal.py:72,845), but App handles only `/billing/return` and `/billing` (App.tsx:410-434); unmatched paths fall through to AccountScreen (App.tsx:436-447).
new_findings.failure_scenario: A signed-in customer cancels hosted checkout; the provider returns them to `/billing/cancel`, which renders the generic account screen without cancellation status or a retry action.
new_findings.fix: Add an authenticated `/billing/cancel` route with cancellation and retry actions, and cover the return path in the billing journey test.

summary: No listed corrections required rechecking. The default hosted-checkout cancellation URL has no matching portal screen; the lane overlap guard passed with 26 tests.
